sections.content: You know these connectors: *sin embargo* (B1 Unit 1), *por eso* (A2 Unit 5), *además* (A2 Unit 28) and closing markers such as *en resumen* (B1 Unit 13). A problem-solving discussion names the problem, explains its cause, evaluates alternatives and proposes a practical action. Use them to organise the reasoning.

items.spanish: El problema afecta a muchas personas, por eso debemos actuar pronto.
items.english: The problem affects many people, so we must act quickly.

items.spanish: La primera alternativa parece útil; sin embargo, sería difícil aplicarla.
items.english: The first alternative seems useful; however, it would be difficult to implement.

items.spanish: Además, debemos considerar el plazo y el coste.
items.english: Furthermore, we must consider the time frame and cost.

items.spanish: En conclusión, esta solución debería ser la prioridad.
items.english: In conclusion, this solution should be the priority.

sections.content: Move from diagnosis to cause, alternatives and a justified recommendation.
